researchCountCorrections.note: Research counted Infested Prism Radiate as two combined article/module move-row atoms. The P1a atomizer splits each row into damage and Block claims. Only the two Block claims are the A9 value conflict (18 vs 13); the two damage claims agree at 13 and remain captured-unreconciled until P1b2.

Research expected 42 stale Doormaker mechanical atoms. The P1a atomizer yields 36 captured-unreconciled mechanical origins; the remaining 31 Doormaker origins are already policy-reviewed exclusions and must not be double-dispositioned.
